keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Full-text search across the opportunity title and synopsis. Leave empty to return everything matching the other filters.

oppStatuses.title: Opportunity status
oppStatuses.description: Which opportunity statuses to include. Defaults to forecasted + posted (open for applications). "Closed" and "archived" are historical.

agencies.title: Agency codes
agencies.description: Grants.gov agency codes, e.g. "NSF", "DOD-AMC", "USDA-NIFA". Leave empty for all agencies. Codes are validated against the live agency list; an unrecognised code is dropped with a warning rather than silently returning zero results.

eligibilities.title: Applicant eligibility
eligibilities.description: Restrict to opportunities open to these applicant types.

enumTitles: Public and State controlled institutions of higher education
Native American tribal organizations (other than federally recognized)
Nonprofits with 501(c)(3) status, other than higher education
Nonprofits without 501(c)(3) status, other than higher education
For-profit organizations other than small businesses

fundingCategories.title: Funding categories
fundingCategories.description: Restrict to opportunities in these funding activity categories, e.g. Health, Education, Environment.

cfda.title: CFDA / Assistance Listing number
cfda.description: Restrict to one Assistance Listing (CFDA) number, e.g. "93.859". Leave empty for all.

oppNum.title: Opportunity number
oppNum.description: Look up a single opportunity by its exact funding opportunity number, e.g. "PD-25-275Y". When set, all other filters are ignored.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: Sort by open date or close date. An unsupported value silently returns zero rows on Grants.gov's own API, so only these validated options are offered.

enrich.title: Enrich with full detail (award amounts, eligibility text, synopsis)
enrich.description: Grants.gov's search results carry only 10 thin fields (no award amounts, no eligibility text, no description). When on (default), each row is joined with a second call to fetch award ceiling/floor, eligibility text, funding instrument/category and the full synopsis. Turn off for fast, cheap sweeps of just the thin fields. Forced on automatically if minAwardAmount/maxAwardAmount is set, since the amount only exists in the detail record.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within the last N days
postedWithinDays.description: Only return opportunities posted in the last N days (Grants.gov's own "Posted Date" facet, verified live to accept any positive day count, not just its 3/7/14/21-day preset buttons). Cheap way to do an incremental daily pull instead of re-scanning the whole index. Leave empty for no date restriction. Ignored when Opportunity number is set.

minAwardAmount.title: Minimum award ceiling (USD)
minAwardAmount.description: Only return opportunities whose award ceiling (the maximum a single award can pay) is at least this amount. Forces "Enrich" on, since the amount lives only in the per-opportunity detail record. Excludes: unposted "forecast" listings with no detail record at all (~3% of the index), AND opportunities whose detail record has no ceiling set at all -- Grants.gov spells this as the literal string "none", measured live at roughly a third to half of posted opportunities. This is common, not a rare edge case.

maxAwardAmount.title: Maximum award ceiling (USD)
maxAwardAmount.description: Only return opportunities whose award ceiling is at most this amount. Same exclusions as Minimum award ceiling: forces "Enrich" on and drops any opportunity with no usable ceiling (no detail record, or the detail record's ceiling is literally unset).
